text: Russian forces occupy positions in Kivsharivka and Nova Sich. Kupyne and Kudiivka were captured by the RuAF. Meanwhile the AFU cleared Ternuvate and Kosivtseve
Ukrainian forces have cleared the northern part of Rizdvyanka/Rozhdestvenske. 8.64 km² cleared
Russian army captured Novomykolaivka on the Druzhkivka direction. 14.3 km² consolidated

Map online. Russian forces advanced in Mala Tokmachka, Novodanylivka (already reported on X), in Petrivka (south of Druzhkivka), and captured the forest north of Okhrimivka. The villages of Hirke (Omelnyk direction), Kutuzivka/Stepy and Vilne (Dobropillya direction) were fully captured by the RuAF. Overall 42.47 km² were captured.
